annotations.title: Get embed and SEO tags for a video

description: [Free] Returns ready-to-paste markup for a finished PageToVid video: an HTML video element, Open Graph and Twitter player meta tags so the page unfurls as a playable video, and a schema.org VideoObject JSON-LD block.

description.description: Overrides the share description. Defaults to a sentence written in the video's language.

page_url.description: The page this markup will be pasted into. Used for og:url so a share resolves to your page rather than nothing.

title.description: Overrides the title in the share card. Defaults to the video's own title.

video_id.description: The video_id of a finished render.

name: get_video_embed
